_comment: Shared contract between the pinned Render CLI's sandbox FILE transport (lego/cli/sandbox_contract_test.go drives the real pkg/sandbox.Repo against this) and bex-api's handlers, which must be proven to emit exactly these bytes. Sibling of sandbox-exec-contract.json; w7/m150 t001. Update both sides together. Every value here was read from the pinned client at v1.1.3-0.20260909214233-a764810a7682 (pkg/sandbox/files.go, pkg/sandbox/repo.go, pkg/client/client_gen.go), not from help output.

connect._comment: NewConnectSandboxFilesRequest (client_gen.go:20018-20046): POST, no request body, ownerId and path as form-style query params. operation is a path segment, not a body field.
connect.responseMethodIsAuthoritative: the client issues the transfer with the `method` value bex returns in the connect response (repo.go:165,198), so bex chooses it; the fixture exercises PUT for upload and GET for download.

upload._comment: Repo.UploadFile (repo.go:159-190). The body is streamed: a directory is tarred and gzipped on the fly with contentLength -1, so bex must not require Content-Length and must not buffer the whole file.
upload.singleFileBody: raw bytes, not tarred — measured by TestPinnedSandboxFileTransportMatchesBexContract, whose uploaded body is byte-identical to the source file. Only a DIRECTORY is tarred and gzipped.

download._comment: Repo.DownloadFile (repo.go:192-220). No request body. The local filename may come from Content-Disposition; a directory arrives as a tar stream.

archivePolicy._comment: pkg/sandbox/files.go. These are the client's own rules; bex must not rely on the client to enforce them, but must not break them either.
archivePolicy.skipsNonRegularNonSymlink: sockets and devices are skipped rather than aborting the archive
archivePolicy.truncationDetected: a truncated archive must not read as success; archive/tar stops at the end-of-archive marker, so the client wraps the body in a terminatedReader and a gzip trailer check catches a short body

nonGoals._comment: Recorded so a later reader does not re-litigate them.
nonGoals.sandboxGroups: deliberate non-goal (approved w7 brainstorm item 3); sandbox-groups commands stay ungraded
nonGoals.appSsh: App SSH restrictions are unchanged by this work
